Congratulations on qualifying for Specialty Benefits!

Hello [FirstName],
Welcome to Intel® Technology Provider OPTANE Data Center Specialty Benefits! As a OPTANE Data Center Specialist you can take advantage of Specialty Benefits specifically designed to help you create winning cloud solutions and give you a competitive edge in the marketplace when deploying Intel®-based solutions.
As a qualified OPTANE Data Center Specialist, you are eligible for Specialty Benefits* that are designed to help you grow your cloud business including:
OPTANE Data Center Specialist designation Intel Promotion of your Company as a Cloud Specialist Customer Matchmaking Opportunities Additional Points when purchasing Intel® Server Products for Cloud Access to Intel Cloud Resources Facilitated qualification for Intel® Cloud Builders Priority invitations to industry events and training sessions Access to Cloud Experts
Thank you again for being an active Intel Technology Provider.
Access Benefits >
*Benefits may vary by geography.
